setCooldown-actor.label: Actor
setCooldown-actor.tip: Set a global cooldown for this actor

set.name: Set
set.tip: Set the cooldown time of this cooldown key and start the cooldown timer

increase.name: Increase
increase.tip: Increase the cooldown time of this cooldown key and start the cooldown timer

decrease.name: Decrease
decrease.tip: Reduce the cooldown time of this cooldown key (minimum is 0)

setCooldown-key.label: Cooldown Key
setCooldown-key.tip: Get the actor's global cooldown object by this cooldown key
